name: r3-q3-daily-nul-valve
description: Fix round Q3 (B1): decision.js splices the stored valve deveui into every irrigation_events INSERT that names a valve (lines 172, 199, 238, 293, 324, 367, 390, 432), quote-doubled only. A NUL ends the statement, so Node-RED writes no event row for that zone; the schedule stamp of an IRRIGATE decision is a separate statement and is still written, and dispatch refuses the non-hex key. Zones 1-6 are SWT (irrigate, below threshold, quote before the NUL, valid control, no data, clock jump); 7-11 are DENDRO (no recommendation, stale, clock jump, irrigate, valid control with no recommendation). Record legacy and --scoped.
